_readme: Search aliases. Edit this file by hand — it is meant to grow.
Format: "what we should search for": ["what people actually type", ...].
When a word in the query matches one of the spellings on the right, the
word on the left is searched as well. Everything is matched after
normalization, so case, hyphens and Georgian/Latin script do not matter
and you do not need to list both scripts of the same spelling.
The key is searched as plain text, so it should be something that really
appears in a product title, a brand, or a category label. A key may be
This is the layer that pays for itself. Character transliteration handles
სამსუნგი -> samsungi on its own; it will never turn ელჯი into LG, because
that is not transliteration, it is what the brand is called in Georgian.
To find out what to add, open the site and run __getSearchQueries() in the
browser console. Queries with n:0 are the ones missing an alias.
Note: მაცივარი and სარეცხი are listed below although the Telavi campaign
currently stocks neither. They cost nothing to keep and will start working
by themselves the day a fridge or a washing machine enters the catalog.
